acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: After CLEAN_INSTALL, the final installed application starts, stops cleanly and starts again from the same sealed installer without legacy migration or rollback.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: Install status PASS; first start reaches local_ready; controlled stop confirms owner exit; restart reaches local_ready; installerSha256 and buildId are identical across all records; migrationAttempted=false; rollbackAttempted=false.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: Electron, backend, installer and diagnostics expose one identical buildId and one identical release identity tuple.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: All four consumers report the same buildId, productVersion, stageVersion, sourceCommit, sourceTree and manifest SHA256, with zero mismatches.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: Exactly one backend AppRuntime owns the installed business runtime at every observed point.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: Observed active AppRuntime owner count never exceeds one; crash/restart sequence yields one trusted replacement owner and zero overlapping owners.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: Installed runtime never reads or obeys any legacy safe-mode fallback source after accepted authority exists.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: Legacy safe-mode file, environment, desktop settings, renderer storage and system-policy mutations produce zero authority changes; Yance29 SQLite remains sole authority.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: local_ready is impossible until credential hydration and all required authority projections agree.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: Every local_ready transition is preceded by successful credential hydration, trusted owner validation and projection agreement; injected early-ready mutation is rejected.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: The installed application reaches local_ready while offline and reports explicit, truthful capability state.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: With network unavailable, local_ready completes within the defined timeout; unavailable external capabilities are explicit; no false online capability is reported.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: The final installed tree contains zero old runtime code, duplicate runtime entrypoints or forbidden legacy residue.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: Canonical installed-tree inventory and process/residual scan report zero forbidden files, zero duplicate runtime entrypoints and zero legacy runtime processes.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: The final installer is produced from clean staging and never uses an old installer plus app.asar.unpacked overlay or post-install runtime patch.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: Staging starts empty; every payload byte has current-session provenance; overlay/post-install patch scanners report zero hits; sealed installer hash remains unchanged.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: Every startup failure exposes machine-readable buildId, failedPhase and stable reasonCode.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: Each injected startup failure produces valid JSON containing the exact buildId, non-empty failedPhase and allowlisted reasonCode; no narrative-only failure record is accepted.

acceptanceChecks.formalRequirement: All stage-level release evidence is machine-readable JSON, schema-valid, SHA256-pinned and joined to one final identity tuple.
acceptanceChecks.passOracle: A01-A10 each appear exactly once; every referenced child JSON parses and validates; every reference has SHA256; all records share source, buildSessionId, buildId and installerSha256; no development evidence is referenced.
